  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(title, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(description, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(skills_json, '')) LIKE '%financial%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mention_financial,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(title, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(description, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(skills_json, '')) LIKE '%data%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mention_data,
